solutions.title: Sort and compare
solutions.strategy: Sort both strings and compare the normalized character order.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting dominates the work for strings of length n; the final comparison is linear.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Both implementations materialize sorted character sequences proportional to the input length.

solutions.title: Counting map
solutions.strategy: Increment counts from one string and decrement them with the other string.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each character from both strings is processed a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The count map stores one entry per distinct character, where k is the character variety.
